study.title: Acupuncture effect on brain default mode network connectivity in breast cancer patients with hot flashes: A randomized controlled trial
study.study_design: Randomized controlled neuroimaging trial with acupuncture intervention
study.randomization: Stated as randomized controlled trial; specific randomization procedure details in supplementary materials not provided
study.blinding: All analyses were blinded; analysts were unaware of group assignments
study.population: Female breast cancer patients with hot flashes, breast cancer patients without hot flashes, and healthy controls
study.disease_condition: Breast cancer with hot flashes (vasomotor symptoms)

study.exclusion_criteria: Detailed exclusion criteria in supplementary materials; MR contraindication was one stated exclusion criterion

extraction_notes.note: Detailed inclusion and exclusion criteria for BC-HF patients are stated to be in supplementary materials, which were not provided. These cannot be extracted.
Specific acupoints used in acupuncture treatment are listed in Supplementary eTable 1, which was not provided. Only narrative description of the protocol is available in the main text.

Detailed MRI acquisition parameters (scanner, field strength, TR, TE, voxel size, preprocessing pipeline, analysis software) are stated to be in supplementary materials (section 2.3), which were not provided. These cannot be extracted.

Baseline demographic and clinical information for each BC-HF participant listed in supplementary eTable 2. Menopausal status details and endocrine therapy types are in supplementary eTable 3. These supplements were not provided.
Full protocol and analysis plan stated to be available in eSAP 1 (supplementary analysis plan), which was not provided.
No deqi, sensory response, or acupuncture sensation instruments or data were reported in the main text. It is unclear whether any such measures were collected.
No expectancy, credibility, or blinding success data were reported for any arm. The paper does not mention assessment of treatment expectancy or blinding integrity in participants.
No sham acupuncture or placebo control arm was included. The authors acknowledge this as a limitation, stating the trial was not designed to evaluate efficacy of real acupuncture versus placebo.
No waiting-list control group (no treatment) was included, which prevents differentiation between treatment effects and natural recovery or regression to the mean.

The paper states '24 BC-HF' in the abstract and methods but the CONSORT flow diagram shows 25 assessed for eligibility and allocated, with 22 analyzed. The text in Table 1 shows BC-HF N=24, but Table 2 shows N=22. The discrepancy may reflect different populations (enrolled vs. analyzed). Extraction uses 24 for enrollment and 22 for analysis.
extraction_notes.source_location: Abstract, Methods 2.1, Table 1, Table 2, CONSORT Fig. 1, page 2–3

extraction_notes.note: The paper states neuroimaging data for BC-HF were acquired at baseline and after therapy (n=20 analyzed for neuroimaging per CONSORT), but clinical data were collected at baseline, post-therapy, and follow-up (n=22 analyzed clinically). The n_analyzed values differ between neuroimaging and clinical outcomes.
extraction_notes.source_location: CONSORT flow diagram Fig. 1; Methods 2.1; Results 3.2–3.3, pages 2–4

extraction_notes.note: The exact coordinate space (MNI, Talairach, or other) for any reported brain regions is not specified in the main text. No coordinate table is provided; all results are reported as network edges between named regions without MNI/Talairach coordinates.

Fig. 2 shows FC chord diagrams and violin plots for all pairwise DMN region comparisons, but specific numerical FC values and full statistical results for all pairs (e.g., FC_LT-RA, FC_RA-RT, FC_PCC-LT, FC_RT-LT, FC_PCC-RA, FC_LA-RA, FC_MPFC-LT, FC_MPFC-RT) are only visible in the figure and figure legend. Exact values could not be read from the PDF with certainty.

Fig. 3 shows violin plots for post-treatment FC changes for FC_RA-RT, FC_MPFC-RT, FC_PCC-LT, FC_PCC-MPFC. Specific numerical values for FC_PCC-LT and FC_PCC-MPFC changes are not reported in text; only significance stars (p < 0.05) are shown in the figure.

The label 'left RT' in Fig. 3 caption ('increased FC was also presented between the posterior cingulate cortex (PCC) and left RT') appears inconsistent with 'RT' being labeled as 'right temporal gyrus' throughout the paper. This may be a typographical error or may refer to a different region. Extracted as written in caption.

The positive-responder correlation results are reported as r = -0.73 in the results text and r = -0.73 in Fig. 4A, but the abstract reports r = 0.726. The discrepancy between r = -0.73 and r = 0.726 may reflect rounding and/or sign convention differences. Both values are preserved as reported in respective locations.
extraction_notes.source_location: Results section 3.3, page 4; Abstract, page 1; Fig. 4A, page 6

extraction_notes.note: No FACT-B follow-up data (at 4–6 months) were reported in the results section. Only post-treatment FACT-B data were explicitly reported.
The BC-NF and NC groups did not receive acupuncture and only had baseline imaging. Any group comparisons involving these groups are cross-sectional, not pre-post treatment comparisons.
